shape: GET /api/tracking-sink/rollups?by=producer — one row per (run_id, node_id, prompt_version, day)
why: trackingIngest.ts producerField keys every feedback OUTCOME record on node_id/run_id. If both spellings and the nested envelope miss, producerKeyOf collapses to "unknown:unknown", the record still saves, and optimizer.analyzeNode reads it as no feedback rather than as a broken pull.
note: The producer sends SNAKE_CASE and never nests. trackingIngest's camelCase and nested-producer fallbacks exist for other senders, not for this one — this fixture pins what kugel-data actually emits.
